GPP — Week 1 (D-51 to D-44) — Restore structural tolerance, aerobic support, and technical rhythm.

D-50 (Friday) — Aerobic support
Why: keep easy aerobic work to restore and support recovery.
- Easy Assault Bike: 25 min continuous; RPE 6; zone 2.
  Cue: sit tall, steady cadence, breathe through your nose.
  Purpose: rebuild aerobic repeatability with very low damage.
  Why today: follows technical work, so it aids recovery and volume balance.
  Progress: next time 30 min continuous at the same pace.
  Easier: 20 min continuous if legs feel heavy.
  Stop: stop for dizziness, chest pain, or unusual breathlessness.

Your declared hard-sparring/contact session — no extra S&C. Keep freshness priority.

D-47 (Monday) — Alactic sharpness
Why: brief high-speed exposure to keep fast qualities.
- Depth Drop (No Rebound): 6 x 3 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 9.
  Cue: step off a 12-18 in box, absorb and stick the landing, no rebound.
  Purpose: train fast landing and explosive first step.
  Why today: early-phase sharpness before we add heavier work later in the week.
  Progress: next time 6 x 4 reps.
  Easier: replace with step-downs from the box if landing feels unsafe.
  Stop: stop on any uncontrolled landing or sharp knee/ankle pain.

D-46 (Tuesday) — Hard sparring — controlled hard contact
Your declared hard-sparring/contact session — no extra S&C. Keep freshness priority.

D-44 (Thursday) — Light Combat / Technical
Your declared light-combat / technical session. Keep it as scheduled.

D-44 (Thursday) — Strength
Why: build general force with sport-friendly carries and single-leg control.
- Sled Pull Forward (Harness): 3 carries x 30 m; rest 90 sec.
  Cue: drive from your legs and hips, keep posture tall.
  Purpose: load the legs in a low-impact way that mirrors stepping power.
  Why today: gives heavy leg stress away from hard sparring days.
  Progress: next time 4 carries x 30 m.
  Easier: reduce to 20 m per carry.
  Stop: stop for sharp low-back pain or inability to keep posture.
- Cossack Squat: 2 sets x 6 reps each side; rest 90 sec; RPE 6.
  Cue: move the hips back, keep knee tracking over foot, control the way down.
  Purpose: hip control and single-leg mobility for balance.
  Why today: improves side-to-side control for your footwork.
  Progress: next time 2 sets x 8 reps each side.
  Easier: do bodyweight range-of-motion to a box.
  Stop: stop for sharp groin pain or unstable knee.
- Staggered Stance Hold: 2 sets x 20 sec holds (tempo 3-1-3); rest 90 sec; RPE 7.
  Cue: keep a stiff trunk, hold the position, breathe evenly.
  Purpose: train balance and bracing under unilateral position.
  Why today: supports your declared balance limiter.
  Progress: next time 2 sets x 30 sec.
  Easier: shorten hold to 10 sec or reduce reach.
  Stop: stop for joint pain or loss of balance that risks a fall.
- Single-Leg TRX Suspension Hold: 3 holds x 10 sec; full rest between holds; RPE 7.
  Cue: suspend on one leg, keep knee alignment, breathe into your belly.
  Purpose: build single-leg balance and time under tension.
  Why today: direct balance exposure ties into your pressure-fighter work.
  Progress: next time 3 holds x 15 sec.
  Easier: put the other foot lightly on the floor for support.
  Stop: stop if you feel dizzy or unstable.

D-40 (Wednesday) — Alactic sharpness
Why: repeat fast neural exposure for speed quality.
- Depth Drop (No Rebound): 6 x 3 reps; rest 90 sec; RPE 9.
  Cue: box 12-18 in, absorb and stick the landing, no rebound.
  Purpose: brief max-speed landing and rebound control.
  Why today: preserves the minimal speed exposures the plan keeps.

D-39 (Tuesday) — Hard sparring — controlled hard contact

D-37 (Thursday) — Strength
Why: maintain ballistic power and lateral explosiveness.
- Barbell Thruster: 4 sets x 2 reps; full rest 120 sec; perform at max speed.
  Cue: drive the legs and hips, finish tall at the top.
  Purpose: preserve full-body ballistic power for punch drive.
  Why today: keeps power transfer while other work builds.
  Progress: next time add one set if crisp.
  Easier: do dumbbell thrusters with lighter load.
  Stop: stop for shoulder pain or loss of speed on the rep.
- Lateral Bound-to-Slip: 4 sets x 2 reps each side; rest 120 sec; perform at max speed.
  Cue: explode laterally, land soft, reset balance before the next rep.
  Purpose: lateral power and collision avoidance timing.
  Why today: trains side-step speed for entries and angles.
  Progress: next time 4 sets x 3 reps each side.
  Easier: lower horizontal distance or do single-leg hops for control.
  Stop: stop for sharp ankle or knee pain.
- Landmine Push Press: 2 sets x 6 reps; tempo 3-1-3; RPE 6-7; rest 90-120 sec.
  Cue: use a split stance, drive through the floor, finish fast.
  Purpose: loaded shoulder power with a safety-first pattern.
  Why today: supports upper-body transfer without heavy spinal loading.
  Progress: next time 3 sets x 6 reps.
  Easier: reduce load or switch to single-arm landmine with lighter weight.
  Stop: stop for sharp shoulder pain or dizziness.

D-33 (Monday) — Strength
Why: combine neural speed with strength to keep transfer to punching.
- Barbell Thruster: 4 sets x 2 reps; rest 120 sec; perform at max speed.
  Cue: compress the knees, drive, then press quickly overhead.

  Why today: early SPP anchor for power transfer.
  Progress: next time add one set if speed stays high.
  Easier: do dumbbell thrusters with lighter weight.
  Stop: stop if bar speed drops markedly or shoulder pain appears.
- Lateral Bound-to-Slip: 4 sets x 2 reps each side; rest 120 sec; perform at max speed.
  Cue: push off your legs, land softly, recover balance.
  Purpose: side-to-side power for angle creation.
  Why today: supports explosive movement in the ring.
  Progress: next time 4 sets x 3 reps each side.
  Easier: reduce distance and emphasize control.
  Stop: stop for sharp ankle or knee pain.
- Landmine Push Press: 2 sets x 6 reps; tempo 3-1-3; RPE 6-8; rest 90-120 sec.
  Cue: split stance, drive through the floor, finish fast.
  Purpose: safe loaded shoulder drive for punch follow-through.
  Why today: transfers into upper-body drive without heavy spinal load.
  Progress: next time 3 sets x 6 reps.

TAPER — Week 7 (D-6 to D-0) — Protect rhythm, confidence, and freshness.
D-5 (Monday) — Freshness primer
Why: small, very fast exposures to keep first-step and pocket bursts crisp.
- Explosive First-Step Cue: 2 x 5 sec; rest 120 sec.
  Cue: sharp first pressure step, then reset.
  Purpose: prime first-step explosiveness without fatigue.
  Why today: last targeted speed touch before pre-fight taper.
  Progress: none this block.
  Easier: 1 x 5 sec if recovery feels low.
  Stop: stop for sharp calf or ankle pain.
- Pocket Frame-Burst Touch: 1 x 5 sec; rest 120 sec.
  Cue: small controlled burst from the pocket, then settle.
  Purpose: rehearse short power bursts for entries.
  Why today: keep the motor pattern for quick pressure.
  Progress: none this block.
  Easier: do a step-jab instead of the burst.
  Stop: stop if shoulder or elbow hurts.
- Pull-Counter-Reset: 1 x 5 sec; rest 120 sec.
  Cue: pull to create space, counter quickly, then settle.
  Purpose: rehearse the pull-counter timing and reset.
  Why today: keep reactive timing fresh with minimal load.
  Progress: none this block.
  Easier: do the movement without a partner, shadow-only.
  Stop: stop for sharp pain.
